# The shared reference set

The five skills share one body of fact: the class format, the formula
language and its function catalogue, the statechart, rights and rules,
commits and previews, querying, and the diagnostic codes. It is written
once here and each SKILL.md points into it, so nothing is said twice and
nothing drifts.

**Status on 2026-11-09: not written.** The set is to be generated by a
script under `scripts/` from the sources below, not written by hand, so a
change in the engine regenerates it. Until then a skill that needs a fact
reads the source directly.

| Planned file | Generated from |
|---|---|
| `class-format.md` | ADR-0013 (variables and types), ADR-0014 (tables), ADR-0018 (metadata and wire format), ADR-0031 and ADR-0032 (schemas, objects, vocabulary), ADR-0033 (attachments), ADR-0034 (ranges), ADR-0039 (versions and terminal states) |
| `formulas.md` | ADR-0019 (grammar, coercion, comparison, dates, text, errors), ADR-0004 (numbers), ADR-0005 (blanks), ADR-0022 (exact money), ADR-0023 (calendar day), ADR-0024 (division and IFERROR) |
| `functions.md` | `internal/formula/catalog.json`, the function catalogue the conformance suite runs |
| `statechart.md` | ADR-0008 (semantics), ADR-0040 (transitions as commits, eventless chains, snapshots, the `_states` view) |
| `rights-and-rules.md` | ADR-0028 and ADR-0041 (field rights per state, per-transition rules), ADR-0010 (access as predicates), ADR-0009 (actions) |
| `commits-and-previews.md` | ADR-0015 (commits and recalculation), ADR-0025 (evaluate without committing), ADR-0026 (idempotency keys, business dates), ADR-0027 (the principal), ADR-0042 (a moment the caller chooses) |
| `querying.md` | ADR-0016 and ADR-0020 (LOOKUP and QUERY), ADR-0037 (explicit tables), ADR-0038 (the filter and the read-only SQL endpoint), ADR-0007 (one table per class) |
| `diagnostics.md` | the `Code` constants of `internal/model/diagnostic.go`: what each code means, where it points, what fixes it |

The decision records live in [`../../docs/adr/`](../../docs/adr/); the
conformance suite in [`../../conformance/`](../../conformance/) is the
specification of the formula language.
